commands.name: devdeck
commands.description: Show the Devdeck pane: services, Convex calls, events and errors

tools.name: devdeck_status
tools.description: Read-only. Summarises the running Devdeck dev dashboard for this project: each service and its status, recent Convex calls, and every open dev error in full (compile, type, runtime, Convex). Use it to answer what is failing or erroring in local dev instead of reading logs. Takes no input.

tools.name: devdeck_run
tools.description: Runs a package.json script (build, test:ci, lint, ship) as a card in the running Devdeck, where the user sees its progress and answers its prompts, then waits for it to end and returns the exit code, its errors and last 40 lines. Prefer it to Bash for package scripts while Devdeck runs. Only script names from package.json are accepted.

tools.name: devdeck_restart
tools.description: Restarts a Devdeck service by id (see devdeck_status) and waits until it is ready or fails.

tools.name: devdeck_wait
tools.description: Waits on a Devdeck card (a script run or a service) until it exits, or is ready, or stops at a prompt.

children: Devdeck is not running in this project.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)
